subject: world_language
concept: Discussing an authentic literary work's themes fluently in an extended conversation, in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'sustained fluent discussion' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences discussion points about a literary work's themes in a coherent order
exercise.abstract: Student holds an extended conversation about a literary work's themes fluently in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: conversation demonstrates sustained fluency and genuine engagement with the work's themes, not memorized short answers
misconception_flags: gives only short, disconnected responses rather than sustaining a genuine extended conversation

interest_binding: literary work generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
